## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is a frozen finance snapshot and must never be seeded or written. Elasticsearch source `orders_v1`, target `orders_v2`, alias `orders`. Restricted fields end in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint`; use `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook retry decorators caused duplicate customer emails. Sequential per-invoice embedding was too slow.

## Plan and progress
Done: batched concurrent embeddings (`ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8)`, `CHUNK_SIZE=100`), tenant scoping, shared embedder wiring, 33 search tests passing, and 18,432 documents verified in both indices. Pending: run/verify the full reindex and inspect results. Next command: status unknown; use the configured reindex command.

## Recent work
Rebuild performance improved from 8.42s to 1.19s for 5,000 invoices. Webhook changes are complete with 44 tests passing.
